chain_words.nuance: to refer to a point briefly
to comment on something in passing
to give reasons in support of a view
to state a claim firmly and with confidence

explanation: These words all describe putting forward a view in speech, from a brief mention to a forceful public declaration.

usage_notes.difference: 'Argue' means giving reasons to support a view; 'assert' means stating a claim firmly, sometimes without offering reasons.
